name: Browse popular films and the About screen
description: Launches Reel Tracker, waits for the popular films list and checks its film count, opens About to check the TMDB attribution notice and logo, then goes back to the list. Needs a configured TMDB key (showcase-app/tmdb.properties): without one the app shows the add-your-key screen and the film-count check fails.

steps.description: Wait for the popular films screen title
Wait for the TMDB logo on the About screen
Go back to the popular films list
Wait for the popular films screen title again

assertions.description: The film-count line is shown, which proves the list loaded (the add-your-key screen also carries the title, but no count)
The About screen shows the TMDB attribution notice
assertions.expected_substring: This application uses TMDB and the TMDB APIs but is not endorsed, certified, or otherwise approved by TMDB.

assertions.description: The film-count line is shown again, which proves the loaded list is back and not the add-your-key screen (which shares the title)
